newsitem.title: USA: PMT Services acquires merchant portfolio.
newsitem.headline: PMT Services acquires merchant portfolio.

text.p: PMT Services Inc said Monday it has purchased a merchant portfolio with about 4,000 accounts from Zions First National Bank for an undisclosed amount of cash.
The accounts currently produce about $1 billion in charge volume on an annualized basis. Zions First National Bank is a subsidiary of Zions Bancorp.

In addition, PMT said it has signed an exclusive, long-term marketing agreement with Zions through which PMT will service new merchant accounts generated by Zions Bank's branch office network and Zions affiliates in Nevada and Arizona.
"We expect the commercial bank segment of the small merchant processing business to provide further growth opportunities for PMT," Chief Operating Officer Joe Stewart said in a statement.
